01 / CULTURE · PUBLISHING · FORMAT
Initiated project

«Упаковка»
Доставка смислу

A zine that turns everyday packaging into a carrier for art, literature and Ukrainian-language culture. The idea: a useful object gets a second life as a small publication — and culture travels with the delivery. Pilot format: a 320×320×40 mm pizza box, printed inside and out, 200–300 copies.

02 / BRAND · WEB · SPIRITUAL PRACTICE
Launching soon

SRODNA

«Від сродності — до дії.» A space for self-knowledge, symbolic practices and creative experiments with one’s own reality, built on Skovoroda’s idea of kindred work and Malevich’s suprematist language of form. Brand, identity and website.

05 / TOOL · CONTEXT
Tool · in development

See.direct

A contextual observatory of time. An interface for noticing cycles, reading the present and exploring possible perspectives — without outsourcing decisions to AI. The site is live; its core functions are still being built.

Method: prompting poetry

PROMPT = FORM
One move, shown whole

A prompt is a poetic form: a source, a constraint and a verb.

01 / SOURCE

Skovoroda’s engraving «Не равное всѣмъ равенство»: different vessels, different streams, one source.

02 / PROMPT + CONSTRAINT
«Я ще б хотів, щоб ти взяв сковородинське „неравное всем равенство“ і зробив з ним те саме, що з силуетами.»

The constraint is the silhouettes: a person reduced to a few suprematist shapes.

03 / RESULT

Four vessels, one stream: a suprematist diagram that became the emblem of «different shapes, one flow» on the SRODNA site.

I direct, constrain and select; the model drafts and varies. Sources and quotations are checked by hand before publication.

Art & text

POETRY = ART

Salaries are low. Tools are expensive. Fools are too smart.

FROM THE RENAMING PROJECT, A ZERO-CONTENT TELEGRAM CHANNEL.
TEXT = IMMERSIVE TECHNOLOGY. POETRY = QR CODES, TO BE SCANNED BY HUMAN EYES. POETRY = VR. YOU ARE THE DEVICE.

Erasure poetry · 2018

Blackouts of Constitution

Visual blackout poetry made from Ukraine’s Constitution with Lightshot, Paint and a touchpad. Grand Prix, Conceptual communication, Power of Young contest (Publicis Groupe Ukraine), 2019.

Collection
Virtual exhibition · 2021

Blackouts of Law

A permanent virtual exhibition on unsolved political problems in Ukraine, with Piotr Armianovski, Iya Kiva and Ihor Mitrov.

Enter
Net art · 2019

Renaming project

A Telegram channel with no content except changing avatars and titles. The channel is a sculpture; every appropriate device is a public space.

t.me/renaming
360° video · poetic texts · 2022–2023

Ctrl+Z / They give us Z

They are sending Z signs to us. We cannot undo (ctrl+z or cmd+z) what they did. Poetic texts in the virtual environment of liberated towns of the Kyiv region. With Piotr Armianovski. Shown at Artisterium 15 (Tbilisi), “Ukraine. Under a different Sky” (Warsaw) and Ctrl+Z (Poznań).

Watch on YouTube (part 1 of 3)

Practice & experiments

WORDS / IMAGES / SOUND / MOTION

Content, AI & production

More than a decade of work with text, translation, localization and digital content. I combine editorial thinking with AI-assisted workflows: concept, research, generation, adaptation, quality control and publication.

Content strategyAI workflowsPrompt designCopywritingLocalizationBrand architectureProject coordination

Art, writing & media

Poetry, publications, books, performances and experiments with form. This includes erasure poetry, text-based visual work and collaborations involving VR and 360° video.

Some works are deliberately process-based: drafts, fragments and prototypes are part of the practice, not just steps toward a finished product.

PoetryErasurePerformancePublishingVR / 360°Sound

About

AN OPEN PRACTICE

I work across writing, translation, creative production and project development. I’m interested in how an idea can find the right form, audience and route into everyday life.

  • Born 1988, Rivne · based in Kyiv
  • PEN Ukraine member
  • Author of three poetry collections
  • Poems translated into ten languages
  • Grand Prix, Power of Young, 2019

My work moves between cultural initiatives and digital environments, between language and image, independent authorship and collaboration. I value clear thinking, strong concepts and practical ways to make creative work happen.

This page is a living portfolio. Selected case studies, links and media will be added progressively.
